text: Gromark adds a running stream of digits to the message on a mixed alphabet. The stream starts from a short primer and grows by adding earlier digits.
With the primer 12345, places 26 and 27 both carve Q but land in two different slots of the alphabet: impossible, so this primer is dead whatever the alphabet.
All 15 two-term rules up to 6 back, every 5-digit primer, four forms, a completely free alphabet: no fit on K4 or on any shuffled copper.
